in_sanskrit.name: हरेश्वरी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who resides in Hare (Lord Vishnu), or the goddess who is the consort of Hari (another name for Lord Vishnu).

in_hindi.name: हारेश्वरी
in_hindi.long_meaning: हरी का पत्नी, हरेश्वरी के नाम से संज्ञान देता है कि वह हरि (विष्णु) के साथ स्थित रहने वाली पत्नी है।

in_marathi.name: Hareshwari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Hari (Vishnu)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hareshwari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hareshwari is the name of the goddess who is considered the consort of Lord Vishnu. Her name is derived from 'Hara', meaning lord, and 'Ishwari', meaning goddess. Hareshwari is revered for her compassionate nature and her ability to protect her devotees from harm.
